morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入的计量单位名称；按资料包读作not，词首k不发音，无马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 节：航海、航空及气象中使用的速度单位，等于每小时一海里，即每小时1.852公里。
senses.en_definition: A unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, or exactly 1.852 kilometres per hour.
senses.ms_definition: Ukuran kelajuan 1 batu nautika sejam atau 1.852 km sejam.
senses.nuances: 表示速度，不表示距离；20 knot已经包含“每小时”的意义，无须再写20 knot sejam。英语knot另有“绳结”等义，但资料包中的马来语词条只指速度单位。换算依据：[NOAA](https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/nautical-mile-knot.html)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kapal penyelamat itu bergerak pada kelajuan 20 knot menuju ke lokasi kejadian.
dual_scenarios.zh: 救援船以20节的速度驶向事发地点。
dual_scenarios.en: The rescue vessel proceeded towards the incident site at a speed of 20 knots.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Angin dah cecah 30 knot, jangan keluar naik bot dulu lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kelajuan angin sudah mencapai 30 knot; jangan keluar menaiki bot buat masa ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 风速都到30节了，先别坐船出海啦。
dual_scenarios.en: The wind's already reached 30 knots. Don't head out in the boat yet.
spoken_features: cecah在口语中表示达到某个数值。
句末lah加强劝告语气；正式表达可省略。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kita nak keluar naik bot petang ni ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kita hendak keluar menaiki bot petang ini?
messages.zh: 我们今天下午还要坐船出去吗？
messages.en: Are we still taking the boat out this afternoon?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Angin dah cecah 30 knot, jangan keluar dulu lah.
messages.ms_standard: Kelajuan angin sudah mencapai 30 knot; jangan keluar buat masa ini.
messages.zh: 风速都到30节了，先别出去啦。
messages.en: The wind's already reached 30 knots. Let's stay ashore for now.

etymology.historical_story: The nautical sense comes from English knot. Seventeenth-century sailors estimated a ship's speed with a floating wooden log attached to a rope bearing regularly spaced knots. Counting the knots paid out during a measured interval gave a speed estimate. That practical procedure survives in the modern unit, although navigation instruments have changed. [NOAA](https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/nautical-mile-knot.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: k不出声，读not；脑中放一条打结的测速绳：一节就是一海里每小时。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性的技术单位，没有特殊敬语要求；向非专业听众说明时，可补充公里每小时的换算。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合航运、航空和气象语境。马来语中数词后仍写knot，例如20 knot；不要套用英语复数knots。
